# OpenCode 1.18.31 Trace Fixture

`opencode-1.18.31-real.jsonl` derives from previously captured OpenCode 1.18.31 `opencode run --format json` events and persisted matching `part` records. Event envelope and nested tool state fields remain unchanged. Session/message/call IDs, paths, tool input/output text, and assistant text are sanitized. Token and cost values remain captured values.
